title: Knowledge Check 1 - Lessons 1-5
description: Questions pooled from Lessons 1-5 - Sales Lifecycle. Pass with 80% or higher to move toward unlocking the cert prep exam.

questions.question: A sales operations team reports that reps fail to work a consistent sequence of calls and emails, and managers cannot see whether the sequence was followed. Which Agentforce Sales capability addresses this?
options: Einstein Lead Scoring to rank the leads
Sales Engagement cadences worked from work queues
Opportunity Forecasting to project the pipeline
Data Cloud ingestion to unify the records
questions.explanation: Sales Engagement is the cadence and work queue feature built for exactly this follow-up consistency problem, while the other options target scoring, forecasting, or data, none of which drive a rep's step sequence.

questions.question: A VP asks for a feature that predicts which open opportunities are most likely to close so reps can prioritize their day. Which layer is the correct choice?
options: An Agentforce agent topic built in Agent Builder
A Salesforce Meetings insight
Einstein Opportunity Scoring
Enterprise Territory Management assignment rules
questions.explanation: The verb is predict, and Einstein Opportunity Scoring ranks opportunities from a trained model, whereas an agent reasons and acts rather than scoring.

questions.question: Partners need to register deals and see only their own opportunities in a branded site. What do you recommend?
options: A scheduled report subscription
Quip document sharing on each opportunity
Territory assignment rules on the account
An Experience Cloud partner site with sharing rules
questions.explanation: A branded external portal for partners is an Experience Cloud partner site, since a report, a Quip document, or a territory rule never provides an external login surface.

questions.question: A firm wants an agent to draft and send follow-up emails autonomously, but legal requires that no discounting language ever reaches a customer. Which is the strongest design?
options: Constrain the topic instructions and route discount-related replies to a human approval action
Give the agent a longer instruction and rely on the model to comply
Disable the Einstein Trust Layer so the agent has fewer restrictions
Turn off data masking so the agent can see more fields
questions.explanation: Narrow topic instructions plus an approval action for the risky path is the bounded design, and disabling the Trust Layer or masking would weaken protections rather than solve the legal requirement.

questions.question: A 300-rep org has clean CRM data and a fully fixed, auditable approval process with no natural-language input. What should you recommend instead of an autonomous agent?
options: An Agentforce agent with five custom topics
A Data Cloud ingestion pipeline
Einstein Activity Capture for the reps
A Flow-based approval because the process is deterministic
questions.explanation: A fixed, auditable process with no conversational input is exactly what Flow is built for, while an agent adds nondeterminism and consumption cost the scenario does not need.

questions.question: Before going live with an Agentforce sales agent, the team must protect customer data sent to the model. Which control applies?
options: Turn off field history tracking on the objects
Enable Salesforce Meetings for the pilot group
The Einstein Trust Layer with data masking and zero data retention
Create a scheduled report subscription for the transcripts
questions.explanation: The Trust Layer sits inline between the agent and the model and provides masking and zero data retention, while none of the other options touch data sent to the LLM.

questions.question: Which statement about campaign influence is correct in a standard Sales Cloud org?
options: Campaign influence restricts opportunity access to campaign members
Customizable Campaign Influence attributes opportunity revenue across multiple campaigns using a model and time window you configure
Campaign members can only ever be Leads
A parent campaign disables member statuses on the child campaigns
questions.explanation: Customizable Campaign Influence applies an attribution model and time window so several campaigns share credit, while influence governs attribution rather than access and member status picklists still apply to the hierarchy.

questions.question: An admin enables Enterprise Territory Management so opportunity access follows the account's territory. How does that access combine with the role hierarchy?
options: Territory-based sharing grants access in addition to the role hierarchy and does not remove existing access
It deletes the role hierarchy and replaces it entirely
It only affects account records and never opportunities
It requires the Sales Engagement license for every user
questions.explanation: ETM layers territory-based access on top of the existing sharing model, so it adds visibility via territory assignment rules rather than replacing the role hierarchy or restricting anyone.

questions.question: A rep has qualified a deal and wants to send a formal quote. What must be in place on the Opportunity?
options: A scheduled report subscription on the opportunity
Einstein Activity Capture enabled for the rep
An active territory model that includes the account
Products added from a price book so a Quote can be generated and synced
questions.explanation: Quoting starts from the opportunity's products on a price book, and the generated Quote syncs its lines back to the opportunity, so the other options do not enable quoting.

questions.question: You enable Enterprise Territory Management and want opportunity access to follow territories. What must be true for that access to work?
options: The role hierarchy must be deleted first
Territory assignment rules only ever assign accounts, never opportunities
The territory model must be active and have opportunity assignment rules
Every user must hold the Sales Engagement license
questions.explanation: Territory-based opportunity access only takes effect once the model is activated and opportunity assignment rules are in place, while the role hierarchy is not deleted and licenses are unrelated.

questions.question: A sales manager wants forecast rollups by product family in addition to total revenue. What do you configure?
options: Multiple forecast types in Collaborative Forecasts
A new territory type in the territory model
Customizable Campaign Influence for the pipeline
Einstein Activity Capture for the forecast managers
questions.explanation: Forecast types let Collaborative Forecasts roll up by revenue, quantity, or product family side by side, whereas territory, influence, and activity capture do not produce forecast rollups.

questions.question: An org turns on Einstein Activity Capture and later finds that reports built on standard Task records look empty. Why?
options: The Einstein Trust Layer blocks Task creation for those users
Activity Capture stores email and events in an external store, so they are not standard Task rows
Sales Engagement deletes Tasks when a cadence completes
Territory assignment rules remove the Task records from reports
questions.explanation: Captured email and events live in an external store related to records rather than as Task rows, which is why Task-based reports undercount the captured activity.

questions.question: A team requires reps to follow a repeatable multi-touch sequence of calls, emails, and tasks, with a prioritised call list each morning. Which feature fits?
options: Opportunity Forecasting
Sales Engagement cadences
Enterprise Territory Management
Salesforce Inbox
questions.explanation: Sales Engagement cadences drive the sequenced multi-touch steps and the Work Queue prioritises who to contact, while forecasting only rolls up commit numbers.

questions.question: An org reassigns accounts to territories that do not match its role hierarchy and wants to test a new carve before it goes live. Which feature do you configure?
options: Collaborative Forecasts
Sales Engagement
Salesforce Inbox
Enterprise Territory Management
questions.explanation: Enterprise Territory Management has its own territory hierarchy and model versions you preview then activate, which is exactly what this requirement describes.

questions.question: Managers need a weekly roll-up of each rep's Commit and Best Case amounts against quota. Which feature delivers that?
options: Opportunity Forecasting
Einstein Opportunity Scoring
Salesforce Inbox
Sales Engagement
questions.explanation: Opportunity Forecasting rolls forecast categories up against quota, whereas scoring returns a propensity and the other two drive activity or mailbox logging.
